source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

Instead of simply revising the earlier version, I’ve rebuilt the entire concept according to your feedback.

It is now designed as a fast-paced, 30-second testimonial-style UGC ad featuring multiple Indian testimonials. This allows it to retain the same high-converting psychology and keywords without appearing to copy the winning creative.

I concentrated on all the areas you mentioned:

- A more powerful and direct hook

- An original concept rather than a duplicate of the reference

- Testimonial-based execution

- Quicker pacing that works for Meta

- Keywords centered on energy, confidence, stamina and performance

- Indian actors, along with suitable visual flow and editing possibilities

Please review this and confirm whether it matches the direction you want before I proceed with the final production prompt and scene-by-scene execution.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports rebuilding the concept as a testimonial-style UGC ad featuring multiple Indian testimonials.
